summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend regression for Community Recommendations, Public Provider Profile, and Email Notifications fallback on public URL. Backend pytest suite passed (8/8) validating public profile payload, recommendation permissions/politeness, /recommendations/mine behavior by role, skipped notification persistence without Resend config, and duplicate review prevention. Frontend Playwright checks validated /prestador/:id rendering, share/copy/login-gated recommendation area, client/provider recommendation actions, own-profile guard, and real 'Ver perfil' navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Success toast still appears sticky across navigation in some flows; it does not reliably auto-dismiss during end-to-end interactions.

action_items: Investigate and stabilize toast auto-dismiss behavior after recommendation and route transitions.
Optional hardening: consider exposing full recommendation total (not only returned list length) if records exceed page slice.
critical_code_review_comments: public_provider_profile sets recommendations_total=len(recommendations) after limiting list to 12; this can undercount real totals for highly recommended providers.
No brute-force lockout logic is present in /api/auth/login despite playbook verification expectations (security hardening gap).
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_ client/provider/provider accounts and related request/offer/review/recommendation records via public APIs during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested flows are passing on backend and mostly validated in UI. If UI polish is addressed, re-run recommendation UI checks and verify toast lifecycle. Consider adding one UI scenario that deterministically creates+reviews an offer and confirms 'Atendimento avaliado' badge visibility.
rca of the issue: Sticky toast behavior is likely state lifecycle related in App.js: message is shared app-wide and can persist while changing screens/users if not cleared consistently on transitions.
